spans.s:
f. (-ति.)
1 The daughter of DAKṢA, wife of KAŚYAPA, and mother of the gods.
2 The earth.
3 Being entire.
E.
अ neg. दा to give, and दिति affix, not giving pain; or अ, and दो to cut or break, क्तिच् aff.

m. (-नः)
A deity, a divinity.
E.
अदिति, and नन्दन, a son of ADITI.

m. only. (-दिः)
1 First, prior.
2 First, pre-eminent.
ind.
(In composition,) Other, et-cetera, as स्वादि the affix सु et-cetera.
E.
आङ् before दा to give, and कि aff.

m. (-रः)
BRAHMĀ, the creator.
E.
आदि and कर who makes.

m. (-त्ता)
BRAHMĀ, as the creator.
E.
आदि and कर्त्तृ who makes.

m. (-विः)
1 A name of

BRAHMĀ.
2

A name of VĀLMĪKI, the first mortal poet.
E.
आदि the first, and कवि a poet.

n. (-णं)
A primary cause.
E.
आदि and कारण a cause.

ind.
From the first, from the beginning.
E.
आदि and तसि aff.

m. (-यः)
A deity, a divinity.
E.
अदिति the mother of the gods, and ढक् derivative aff.

m. (-त्यः)
1 A deity in general.
2 A deity of a particular class; the ĀDITYAS are twelve in number, they are forms of SŪRYA or the sun, and appear to represent him as distinct in each month of the year.
3 The sun.
E.
अदिति the mother of the gods, and घञ् derivative aff.

f. (-का)
Red swallow wort.
E.
आदित्य the sun, and पुष्पिका having a flower, the flower of the sun, from its red colour: see अर्कपुष्पिका.

n. (-लं)
The disc or orb of the sun.
E.
आदित्य and मण्डल a circle.

n. (-त्वं)
Priority, precedence.
E.
आदि and त्व added; also आदिता with तल् aff.

f. (-ता)
Wish to seize.
E.
आङ् before दा to give, desiderative form, क्त aff.

mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु)
Wishing to take or have.
E.
आङ् before दा to give, desiderative form, उस् aff.

m. (-वः)
Name of VIṢṆU or NĀRĀYAṆA.
E.
आदि the first, and देव a god, the first god, the creator.

m. (-षः)
The first male, usually applied to VIṢṆU.
E.
आदि the first, and पुरुष a man.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
First born or existent.
m. (-तः)
BRAHMA.
E.
आदि and भूत been.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
First, prior.
E.
आदि and डिमच् aff.

m. (-जः)
The name of a king; also पृथु.
E.
आदि and राजन् a king, the first king; he was a form of VIṢṆU, and husband of Pṛthvī or the earth.

m. (-हः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
E.
आदि and वराह a boar; the first boar, alluding to VIṢṆU'S avatāra, or incarnation in that form; also similar compounds, as आदिशूकरः, आद्यकोलः, &c.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Commanded, directed.
2

Appointed.
3

Advised, enjoined.
4 Said.
n. (-ष्टं)
Fragments or leavings of a meal.
E.
आङ्, दिश to point or shew, क्त aff.

m. (-ष्टी)
1 A student, a Brahman in the first order.
2 A penitent, one engaged in any expiatory rite.
E.
आदिष्ट what is instructed, and इनि aff.

m. (-वः)
1 Distress, pain, uneasiness.
2 Fault, transgression.
3 An inflictor of distress.
E.
आङ्, दीङ् to decay, deriv. irr.

n. (-नं)
1 Whitening the wall, floor, or seat, &c. upon festival occasions.
2

Embellishing.
3

Inflaming, exciting.
E.
आङ्, दीप to beautify, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Illuminated.
E.
आङ् before दीप to inflame, क्त aff.
